svg.title: Отведение рук с дисками — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. STANDING LATERAL RAISE holding ONE flat circular WEIGHT PLATE in EACH hand. Left: arms down beside thighs, each hand gripping rim of a small plate. Right: raise both arms sideways to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, plate still in each hand. Plates must be circular flat disks with center holes, no dumbbell handle or barbell. Front three-quarter view, standing feet on floor. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
